notes.title: Bedtime Blues coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33961750/48fbc84faa93a213f9981d0a8465042c38a6b142.jpg[/img]

Bedtime Blues Steam Store page is launching today! If you're a fan of horrors and want to play as a young child making it through the night - check out the Bedtime Blues on Steam and add the game to your Wishlist!

Enter the pixelated everchanging world, and play against a randomized AI. Bedtime Blues is a horror, that will bring the shivers down your spine! Play as a youngling surviving through the night in the pixelated horror. Wander around your bedroom, searching for clues to unravel the story - but keep a close eye on the room, as each hour it slowly changes..
